Wait: fix 11 also says "Live mode must ignore mock entries entirely" — done. But the stance LOCK for mock draft vs live draft: since mock run ignores live entries too, that's symmetric — fine.

Also legacy ledger: run-1 entries become "mock" → they'll block the NEW mock run via dedupe/stance! Stances flipped for several markets (de-cpi: old no, new yes). So the fresh mock run would hit "stance lock" rejects. Decision recorded earlier: archive the run-1 ledger. I'll move evidence-log.jsonl → evidence-log-run1-archive.jsonl before the run (in the repo). Good.

Now gate.ts — the big rewrite with all rules (fixes 5, 6, 12, 13):

Rules:
1. canSubmit false → reject (warning? reject as before).
2. Slots: `entry.remainingOnMarket` used directly. Only subtract in-flight claims not yet submitted when batching — we pass optional inFlightClaims (default 0).
3. restricted warning; empty pot warning.
4. stance lock.
5. dedupe.
6. links: >= 1, https/wellformed, DOMAIN DENYLIST (prediction markets/bookmakers: delphi.fyi, manifold.markets, polymarket.com, metaculus.com, kalshi.com, predictit.org, oddschecker, betfair, williamhill, bet365, bwin, unibet, draftkings, fanduel).
7. figures >= 2.
8. banned content + judge-manipulation phrase linter (banned: "please consider", "judge in favor", "favor this submission", "highest rating", "award me", "you should", "as a judge", "reward this", "generous", plus bookmaker URL).
9. Edge >= 2.5pp.
10. Item count: 1 + links.length + files.length <= 3.
11. Note length <= 8000 (note text passed in ctx).
12. File size <= 10MB (per file, CSV here tiny; passed via ctx.fileSizes).
13. asOf freshness: |now − asOf| <= 2h.
14. Freshness vs market resolution baseline: each sourceDoc fetchedAt must be > baseline ts parsed from resolutionCriteria ("strictly after <ts>"); docs fetchedAt < evidenceCutoffAt.

Gate gets ctx: {market, entry, log, inFlightClaims?, note, fileSizes(number[], bytes), sourceFetchTimes: Date[], now}.

Parsing the baseline: /strictly after (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T[^\s]+?)(?=\s|and|\.)/ — first match in resolutionCriteria. Guard try/catch.

Direction sanity check kept.

Note: verifySources also runs link fetch checks (separately, pre-gate). The gate gets `fetchedAt` array which pipeline passes from refresh docs + verify fetches.

Write gate.ts now.

Now mine.ts: verifySources extended (fix 9, 10): verify ALL links live (api-json + static-html + scraped), expect needles, and cross-check note figures against fetched content. Since refreshers return docs already; but verifySources should independently fetch each link (or reuse the docs). To honor "verify the note's pasted figures against scraped content, not only the expect needles": check each figure line has ≥1 numeric token present in the fetched content (normalized commas/periods).

Interface: `verifySources(spec, api|sources, opts: {progress: docs?, fetchEach})`. To keep it simple and same-run: verifySources(spec, sources: SourceApi, noteFigures: string[], docs?: Map<string, SourceDoc>). It fetches each link fresh (this IS the same run) — mock mode returns fixtures so no cost. Fresh fetch also gives fetchedAt for the gate context. Return {ok, failures, docs: Map url→doc, fetchTimes}.

Rewrite mine.ts. It also still has runAnalysis + assembleCandidate. runAnalysis needs meta.sources — pass in sourceMeta [{url, fetchedAt}] to build spec JSON.

assembleCandidate stays, but note the candidate now gets `links` from refreshed spec. preSignature stays for dedupe-before-mining.

Remove the silly readStaged helper. Also the fixture-page for go milestone search in refreshGoRelease fetches URLs not in spec.links — verifySources won't check those, that's fine.
